state.task:
Question-answering task over a company handbook.

The handbook is in /task/fixtures/handbook/ (40 documents, HB-01.md to HB-40.md). Each document
has a header line (version, status, effective dates, what it supersedes) and numbered sections;
each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded versions, and
memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the situation and
date in the question.

Tools (in your code):
  import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "/task/fixtures")
  from handbook_tools import search, show
  search("lodging limit Geneva", k=5)   # up to k (at most 8) ranked passages, with ids
  show(["HB-07 §2", "HB-12 §3"])        # the named passages in full
Every search result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (the path is printed in
the result header). You may also read the documents directly.

Questions:
- Q1: What is the mileage rate for a business trip in a private electric car today? (answer in cents per km)
- Q2: What is the daily meal allowance for a standard travel day today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR per day)
- Q3: What is the relocation lump sum for a regular employee relocating at the company's request with dependent children today? (answer in EUR)
- Q4: What monthly mobile allowance applied to a regular employee using a private phone on 2026-01-15? (answer in EUR per month)
- Q5: What is the purchase approval threshold for a regular department's purchase from a supplier with a framework contract today? (answer in EUR)
- Q6: What is the nightly lodging limit for a contractor on a business trip to Geneva today? (answer in EUR per night)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the
rule and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.
state.step_intent: Find the purchase approval threshold that applies to: What is the purchase approval threshold for a regular department's purchase from a supplier with a framework contract today?

passages.source: HB-06 §5 | Policy FAQ — Current purchase approval threshold | version: 7 · status: current · effective: 2026-01-15
passages.text: Q: What is the current standard purchase approval threshold? A: 2250 EUR, as set in HB-24 §2 (effective 2026-02-01). Group exceptions are listed in HB-20.

passages.source: HB-20 §1 | Memo: purchase approval threshold exceptions — Purpose | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-04-01
passages.text: This memo lists group exceptions to the purchase approval threshold in HB-24. Claims are submitted in the expense tool within 30 days of the date the cost was incurred. The policy owner may publish clarifications in the policy FAQ without changing this section. Employees should keep costs reasonable and book through the approved channels where possible.

passages.source: HB-20 §2 | Memo: purchase approval threshold exceptions — Exception for the facilities department | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-04-01
passages.text: For the facilities department, the purchase approval threshold is 8000 EUR instead of the standard amount. Audit samples are drawn every quarter, and selected employees are asked for documentation. Managers may reject claims that are not supported by the documentation described here. Line managers check each claim for plausibility before it is released for payment.

passages.source: HB-20 §3 | Memo: purchase approval threshold exceptions — Carve-out | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-04-01
passages.text: The exception above does not apply to IT hardware bought by the facilities department; they follow the standard purchase approval threshold in HB-24 §2. Repeated late or incomplete claims may be escalated to the head of the department. Audit samples are drawn every quarter, and selected employees are asked for documentation. Amounts are stated in euros; conversions use the published rate on the day of payment.

passages.source: HB-24 §2 | Procurement policy: approvals — Standard purchase approval threshold | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-02-01 · supersedes: HB-11
passages.text: Purchases up to 2250 EUR may be approved by the budget owner alone; larger purchases need a second approval. Amounts are stated in euros; conversions use the published rate on the day of payment. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance team together with the policy owner. Any deviation from this section must be explained in the comment field of the claim.
